dedupe_keys.name: dataset for patrol sequences of out of service nodes in a power distribution feeders

description: Dataset for Patrol Sequences of Out-of-Service Nodes in a Power Distribution Feeders is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Luiz Dezuo Neto, Joao B. A. London Jr. (University of São Paulo). This release comprises a fictional radial power distribution system located on a road-network from Piedmont, California, USA. The system nodes' coordinates rely on projection EPSG:4326 or WGS 84. The test case mainly comprises 46 switches and 68 buses, totalling two substations with two feeders each. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
